full_prompt_en: A square storybook watercolor and ink illustration shows two long nosed animal characters facing one another beside a rough tree trunk. At left, a small creature stands upright in an oversized rusty orange coat and a tall pointed cap of the same color. Dark green trousers and large brown shoes show beneath the coat, while its pale snout projects toward the seated companion. At right, a much taller creature sits on an exposed root, wrapped in a muted blue coat with an ocher scarf and a brown pack strapped behind its shoulders. Its long pale nose points toward the smaller figure, and one hand holds a tiny pale object close to its chest. Broad rough feet rest on the leaf scattered ground. The tree climbs along the right edge into a dark hollow, and its roots curve around the sitting figure. Behind both characters, a quiet wall of gray green shadow dissolves into pale open space on the left. Yellow, orange, and tan leaves gather in small patches around the root and drift toward the bottom edge. The forms are modeled with fine pencil or ink contours, delicate crosshatching, and translucent watercolor. Soft light from the upper left makes the orange coat glow gently, lifts the pale snouts, and lets deep cool shade remain behind the tree. The wide empty foreground and close exchange of the two figures give the scene a private, curious pause. The picture feels tender and slightly mysterious, with natural detail supporting the quiet meeting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形童话水彩墨线插画描绘两只长鼻子动物角色在粗糙树干旁相对而立。左侧，一只小动物穿宽大的锈橙色外套和同色高尖帽，直立着；外套下露出深绿裤子和大棕鞋，浅色口鼻朝向坐着的同伴伸出。右侧，更高大的动物坐在露出的树根上，裹着低饱和蓝色外套、赭黄围巾，肩后绑着棕色背包。它的长而浅的鼻子指向小个子，一只手把小小的浅色物件握在胸前。粗大的脚落在撒满叶子的地面。树沿右边缘升入深暗树洞，根系在坐着的人物周围弯曲。两只角色身后，安静的灰绿色阴影墙在左侧消散为浅色开放空间。黄色、橙色与浅棕树叶小片聚在根旁，向画面底边飘散。形体由细铅笔或墨线轮廓、轻巧排线和通透水彩塑造。从左上方来的柔光让橙色外套轻轻发亮，抬亮浅色口鼻，并让深冷阴影留在树后。宽裕的空前景与两只角色的近距离交流赋予场景私密、好奇的停顿。图画温柔而略神秘，自然细节托住这场安静相遇。
style_prompt_en: Storybook watercolor illustration rests on fine, slightly trembling ink and pencil contours over softly grained paper. Transparent washes of rusty orange, muted blue, ocher, moss green, and warm gray fill carefully observed shapes without hiding the linework. Small crosshatched marks darken recesses and textured edges, while broad pale areas remain lightly touched. Proportions are charmingly elastic, with elongated curves, compact masses, and oversized rounded endpoints. The composition balances an intimate pair of unequal shapes against a wide open field and one rough vertical anchor. Leaves, grain, and worn surface marks gather selectively near the lower edge rather than covering every space. Diffuse light from one side gently warms saturated accents and lets cool shadow deepen in the background. The atmosphere is tender, contemplative, and slightly curious, with whimsical design grounded by tactile natural textures.
style_prompt_zh: 童话水彩插画立在略微颤动的细墨线与铅笔轮廓上，纸面带柔和颗粒。锈橙、低饱和蓝、赭黄、苔绿与暖灰的透明洗色填入仔细观察的形体，却不盖住线条。细小排线加深凹处和有纹理的边缘，大块浅色区域仅轻轻触及。比例带迷人的弹性，修长曲线、紧凑体块和过大的圆端并存。构图把一对大小不等的亲密形体与宽阔空域、一块粗糙竖向支点平衡。叶状小痕、颗粒和磨损表面标记有选择地聚在下缘附近，而不铺满每处空间。从一侧来的漫射光温和加热饱和重音，让冷阴影在背景加深。气氛温柔、沉思并略带好奇，奇想设计由可触自然肌理扎根。
theme_en: Two long nosed storybook creatures meeting beside a tree
theme_zh: 两只长鼻子童话小动物在树旁相遇
name: Arnold Lobel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
